doc.title: Ingrid Sertso interviewed by Monk Rowe, Woodstock, New York, August 11, 2014

title: Jazz Dance album and Discipline 100
summary: An audio clip prompts her to place it on the Jazz Dance album with a rock drummer.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: Okay. I wanted to put on a piece of music here and see if you can tell me something about it.
Well not really. This is actually — isn’t this a piece that you guys did?
It’s been so much years you can hardly remember.
Vibes come in here a little bit.

That must be from the “Jazz Dance” album. We did an album called “Jazz Dance” and we had a rock & roll drummer. Because the company we did it for, that’s what they wanted, putting our way of playing music together with some rock & roll. It must be “Jazz Dance.”
You will have to ask Karl because he might remember better.
Yeah, it was just something that I saw on YouTube.
I will remind you afterwards that you play it again on Karl’s.
